name: Dense graphs on 20 vertices edge-coloured with 20 colours so every 4-cycle is rainbow
description: construct() -> coloured edges [[u, v, c], ...] of a simple graph on vertices 0..19 with colours 0..19. Every 4-cycle (as a subgraph) must receive four distinct colours, checked over all 4-cycles. Maximize the number of edges. Dense valid colourings for n = 20 are finite evidence on the anti-Ramsey question.

sources.locator: S. A. Burr, P. Erdős, R. L. Graham and V. T. Sós, Maximal antiramsey graphs and the strong chromatic number (1989). Crossref record inspected; Erdős Problem #810 page inspected (Burr, Erdős, Graham and Sós believed no eps*n^2 edges admit an n-colouring with every C4 rainbow; open for C4, resolved for other connected bipartite graphs except complete bipartite ones by Sárközy and Selkow). No finite values are documented. Dense valid colourings for n = 20 are finite evidence on the anti-Ramsey question.
Erdős Problem #810 (open); statement, history and current bounds reviewed 2026-09-24.
JSP-000667; pinned discovery source, independently paraphrased. Primary mathematical attribution follows the papers above.
